bug_title: Selected task cannot be removed or moved to Completed Tasks
root_cause: In `views/index.ejs`, the Added Task checkboxes and Remove button are enclosed inside the `<form action="/addtask" method="POST">` form. Using a single form with `formaction="/removetask"` on the submit button causes the form submission to target `/addtask` instead of `/removetask`. As a result, the `/removetask` Express endpoint in `index.js` is never executed when removing a task.
evidence: In `views/index.ejs`, `<form action ="/addtask" method="POST">` starts before the new task input and ends after the Remove button, wrapping both task addition and task removal elements.
When clicking the Remove button, the form POSTs to `/addtask` rather than `/removetask`, preventing the removal and transfer logic in `index.js` (`app.post("/removetask", ...)` ) from running.
proposed_fix: Separate the form in `views/index.ejs` into two distinct forms: close the first form right after the 'Add Task' button, and wrap the 'Added Task' list and 'Remove' button inside a second form with `action="/removetask" method="POST"`.
verification_plan: Navigate to http://localhost:3000 in a web browser.
Select the checkbox next to an existing task in the 'Added Task' section (e.g., 'buy socks').
Confirm that the task is removed from 'Added Task' and displayed under 'Completed task'.
